title: tc-test-run-result
description: A test run that shows only what failed: counts in words over a bar, the failures with their message, diff and stack, and Re-run failed.

command.description: The command that ran the tests – "npx vitest run"

tests.description: The tests: the failures with their details, and any passed or skipped ones to list

counts.description: Totals, for tests left out of `tests`

total.description: How many tests the run has, so the bar can fill towards it while running

duration.description: How long the run took, in ms

running.description: The run is still going: the counts are live and Re-run waits

open.description: The failures that are open, by id. Unset: the first failure

name.description: The test's own name – "rejects a negative amount"

suite.description: Where it sits – the file or describe path, "ledger › postings"

durationMs.description: How long it took, in ms

expected.description: What the test expected, as text; with `received`, drawn as a line diff

stack.description: The stack as printed; trimmed to the project's frames for display

file.description: The file to open, when the stack doesn't say
